header_sentences: See Nose, and see Mucus, Odour, and Smell.

contexts.text: To inbreathe into his nostrils the breath of lives () = to give him the life of faith and love.
By the nostrils was understood whatever was grateful, from the odour, which = perception. Illustrated.
Those who are at the nostrils are those who enjoy perception.
Concerning the correspondence of Odour and of the nostrils with the Grand Man. General article.

To the province (of the sense of smell and thence of the nostrils) pertain those who are in general perception, so that they may be called perceptions. To these corresponds the smell, consequently its organ. Hence it is that to smell, to scent, to be keen-scented, and also the nostrils, in common discourse are predicated of those who by divination come near the Thing, and also who perceive.

I have spoken with those who, in the Society into which I was sent... pertain to the province of the nostrils, from which it has been given me to know... that they are perceptions; for they perceived whatever has happened in the Society in general; but not so much in particular as those who are in the province of the eye...
But those who relate to the interiors of the nostrils are in a more perfect state as to perception than those who relate to the exteriors of them. (A representative of them seen.)

The abodes of those who constitute the province of the internal nostrils were there; for they were of the female sex; and the clearness of the perception of those who dwell there is represented by such holes. Explained. SE 4028.
Those who were cast down (from among them) relate to the mucus of the nostrils, who are dull and stupid. Described.

There was then shown me the lucidity in which those live who relate to the internals of the nostrils. Described. It was also shown that they have holes opening at the side, through which they see as it were the sky with stars in the azure. (Further representatives of the perceptions in which are those who correspond to the smell of the internal nostrils.) Described. SE 4031.
The region (of these Spirits) was observed from the plane of the septum of the nostrils rising up towards the plane of the left ear.
The nostrils (are formed) to the sense of the fluent parts in the atmosphere. AC 6057.

The wind of Thy nostrils () = Heaven... because by it is meant the breath of life, thus the Divine life; and as this makes the life of Heaven, by the wind of the nostrils of Jehovah is signified Heaven.
It is said through the nostrils (), because the respiration is through them, and through the respiration there is life.
As by the presence of Heaven where the Lord is evils and falsities are cast into Hell, this effect also is signified by the wind of the nostrils of Jehovah. Illustrated.
The nostrils correspond to the perception of truth.
The interiors... which are of perception (have their province allotted) in the province of the nostrils.
Those in the Grand Man who are in the nostrils are in perception.
Hence by the nostrils (in the Word, is signified) perception.

As the respiration passes through the nostrils, by them is signified perception; and one who is intelligent is said to be a man of sharp nostril; and one who is not intelligent to be of dull nostril. DWis 6. 4.
In the nostrils () = into the perception that the will of good and the understanding of truth = and thus the soul of lives = was in him.
To inbreathe into the nostrils the soul of lives = to implant the perception of good and truth.
They were so enraged that smoke and fire came out of their nostrils.
When they hear these truths they compress the nostrils, lest the odour of them should... excite nausea; but they open all their senses to falsities, and draw them in as whales do water.
There is a like reciprocal mutual conjunction... of odour and the nostril.
With his nostrils stopped up he went near those who were in the odour of Heaven...
The mamillary processes imbibe the phlegm of the medullary substance of the brain through their interstices, and secrete it into the nostrils... SE 1267.

These are altogether external men, because they obstruct the respiration through the nostrils; and therefore it is determined through the mouth, and thus into the pharynx, otherwise than is wont to be the way of natural respiration, which is through the nostrils, by reason of the concordance of the brain and its animation with external things...
Such a respiration (of the Most Ancients) flowing out through the lips, and entering through their mouth, thus through the nostrils, and through the Eustachian tube into the ear...
They inflicted on my left nostril an uncomfortable coldness...
For the spirit, and wind, of the nostrils, in the supreme sense, = Divine truth. Illustrated.
The nostrils correspond to perception.
The spirit of our nostrils () = the life of the perception of good and truth.
The perception of the mind corresponds to the odour of the nostrils...
4. The nostrils, from the correspondence of the respiration through them, = perception...
5. The continuation (of the lungs) thence is into the nostrils and the tongue...
